in_sanskrit.name: ईश्वर
in_sanskrit.meaning: ईशान, ईश्वर और ईशानियाँ के प्रतिपादक, ज्योतिष्मा, पूजारा, धन्यवाद, स्वतंत्र और सहज शक्ति के साथ समुक्त हुए प्रभावशाली शक्ति

data.cultural_impact: The name "Eswara" holds great significance in Hindu culture, representing the supreme deity, Shiva, in his form as the ruler and controller of the universe. Eswara is often associated with the concepts of wisdom, destruction, and regeneration. Shiva as Eswara is known to grant boons to his devotees, bring prosperity, and bestow wisdom upon them.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spiritualism, Eswara is considered the embodiment of wisdom and power, representing the highest understanding and knowingness. As a manifestation of Shiva, Eswara symbolizes the cosmic cycle of creation, preservation, and destruction. Devotion to Eswara is believed to lead to spiritual growth, inner peace, and ultimately, enlightenment.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Eswara continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Devi Eswara in Bali, Indonesia attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Eswara, which means "Lord of the Universe". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Eswara represents the supreme cosmic power, Shiva, who is the embodiment of absolute consciousness, destruction, and creation. This name signifies the transformative force of the universe, ever-changing yet eternal.

seo.title: Eswara - Hindu Goddess of Marriage and Fertility
seo.meta_description: Eswara is a Hindu goddess of marriage and fertility. Her name means the one who is 'all pervading' and 'lord of the universe'.
seo.description_paragraph: Eswara, also known as Parvati or Shiva's consort, is a revered goddess in Hinduism. She is the embodiment of love, compassion, and motherhood. Her name, which means 'the one who is all pervading' and 'lord of the universe', reflects her immense power and significance in Hindu mythology. Eswara is worshipped as a symbol of marital bliss, fertility, and prosperity. She is often depicted with multiple arms, each holding a symbolic object, and adorned with beautiful ornaments.
